properties.summary: Phase 1 floated under 100 MW on land at Drax Power Station; longer-term ambition to 1 GW. The “carbon-negative data centre” claim rests on unproven bioenergy with carbon capture and storage. Environmental impact assessment screening: the council ruled no full assessment required (contested).
